name: Kelley (United States)
description: Red field with a navy blue stripe along the bottom, charged towards the hoist with a navy blue four-pointed star outlined in white.
history: Kelley is a city in Story County, Iowa. Flags of the World records that the design won a residents' vote announced in the city newsletter in July 2022 and was first flown in front of city hall in December 2022; Wikidata gives 2022 as the start of use.
